instruction.text: Read the information and answer the question.

atoms.a:
Yaz went to the bakery. She bought a croissant for 52p, a bap for 69p, a baguette for £1.20 and a doughnut for 75p.

How much did Yaz spend in total? Add up all the values in pence.

hint.text: Don’t forget to convert to pounds!

atoms.a:
Lois and Tim decide to go shopping. In the first shop they buy a t-shirt which cost £13.78 and a pair of jeans for £16.41.

How much do they spend in the first shop?

In the second shop, they buy some comics for £7.65 and, in the last shop, they buy a packet of crisps for 80p.

How much have they spent all together?

atoms.b: In total, Lois and Tim spent £<mat><gap>38.64</gap></mat> at the shops.
